```{r setup}
#| code-summary: "Setup: the task's runs, trials and items"
source(here::here("common.R"))
task_id <- params$task_id
source(here::here("tasks/_task_report.R"))
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Summary

**Data:** `r data_ref`.

- `r fmt_n(n_runs)` scored runs from `r fmt_n(n_children)` children in
  `r n_distinct(runs$dataset)` datasets;
  `r if (share_adaptive == 0) "all used the fixed form" else if (share_adaptive == 1) "all used the adaptive form" else paste(fmt_pct(share_adaptive), "used the adaptive form")`. A run takes a median of `r round(minutes_median, 1)`
  minutes.
- `r if (has_se) paste0("Reliability of the scores is ", rng(reliability$reliability), " across datasets, and scores") else paste0("The score is a ", score_type_label, ", not an IRT estimate, so it has no standard error and reliability is not estimated here. Scores")`
  correlate with age at r = `r rng(age_cor$r)`.
- `r if (nrow(retest_big) > 0) paste0("Between a child's first two waves, scores correlate r = ", rng(retest_big$r), if (nrow(retest_big) == 1) paste0(" in the one dataset (", dataset_labels_named[retest_big$dataset], ")") else paste0(" in the ", nrow(retest_big), " datasets"), " with 50 or more children in two waves (median gap ", rng(retest_big$gap_months, digits = 0), " months)", if (nrow(retest) > nrow(retest_big)) paste0("; ", nrow(retest) - nrow(retest_big), if (nrow(retest) - nrow(retest_big) == 1) " smaller dataset is shown below" else " smaller datasets are shown below") else "", ".") else "No dataset has 50 or more children with two waves of this task yet."`
- `r if (!has_items) "There is no calibrated item bank." else if (by_language) paste0("Items are calibrated separately for each language, so scores are not on one scale across languages (", paste0(lang_names[item_langs], " ", count(items, lang)$n, collapse = ", "), " items); ", fmt_pct(share_calibrated, 1), " of responses are to calibrated items.") else paste0("The calibrated bank has ", fmt_n(nrow(items)), " items; ", fmt_pct(share_calibrated, 1), " of responses are to calibrated items.")`
  `r if (!check_chance) "" else if (sum(item_lang$below_chance) == 0) "No item is answered below chance in any language." else paste0(sum(item_lang$below_chance), if (sum(item_lang$below_chance) == 1) " item-language combination is" else " item-language combinations are", " answered below chance.")`
:::

# Deployment and forms

```{r forms, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-forms
#| fig-cap: "Runs per month, by task version and adaptive or fixed form."
runs |>
  mutate(month = lubridate::floor_date(as.Date(time_started), "month")) |>
  count(month, form) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, fill = form)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Runs") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r form-table}
#| label: tbl-forms
#| tbl-cap: "Forms in the release: version, adaptive or fixed, and the variant settings recorded with each run."
runs |>
  count(version, adaptive = if_else(adaptive, "adaptive", "fixed"), max_time,
        max_incorrect, corpus = coalesce(corpus, "")) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  mutate(n = fmt_n(n)) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Version", "Form", "Time limit (min)", "Errors allowed",
                             "Item bank", "Runs"))
```

# Coverage

```{r coverage, fig.height=4.5}
#| label: fig-coverage
#| fig-cap: "Children by dataset and age at their first run of the task (datasets with 50 or more runs)."
first_runs |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  mutate(age = floor(age)) |>
  count(dataset, age) |>
  by_ds() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = dataset_label, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n, colour = n > 60), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:15) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = NULL)
```

`r fmt_n(n_distinct(wave_runs$user_id[wave_runs$wave >= 2]))` children have
this task in two or more waves (runs at least 90 days apart).

# Item bank

```{r no-items, eval=!has_items, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("The score does not come from an item response model, so there is no",
    "calibrated item bank. @fig-exposure shows how often each item was shown.\n")
```

```{r wright-text, eval=has_items, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("The calibrated item difficulties and the children's scores share one scale",
    if (by_language) "within each language" else "",
    "(@fig-wright). Items far below most children's scores tell us little about",
    "them, and children above the hardest items are at the bank's ceiling.\n")
```

```{r wright, eval=has_items, fig.height=if (by_language) 5 else 4.5}
#| label: fig-wright
#| fig-cap: "Calibrated item difficulties (top) and children's scores on their first run (bottom), on the same scale; one panel per language for tasks calibrated by language."
wright <- bind_rows(
  items |> transmute(what = "Items", value = difficulty, lang),
  first_runs |> transmute(what = "Children", value = score,
                          lang = if (by_language) substr(language, 1, 2) else NA)) |>
  filter(!by_language | lang %in% item_langs) |>
  mutate(what = factor(what, c("Items", "Children")),
         language = if (by_language) lang_names[lang] else "All languages")
ggplot(wright, aes(x = value, fill = what)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(what ~ language, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Items = "#4477AA", Children = "grey45"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Ability scale", y = NULL) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside")
```

```{r exposure, fig.height=3.5}
#| label: fig-exposure
#| fig-cap: "Responses per item in the release, calibrated and not (per language for tasks calibrated by language)."
item_use |>
  mutate(calibrated = if_else(calibrated, "calibrated", "not calibrated")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = responses, fill = calibrated)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(calibrated = "#4477AA", `not calibrated` = "#CC6677"),
                    name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Responses per item", y = "Items") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

`r if (has_items) paste0("Children answered ", fmt_n(nrow(item_use)), if (by_language) " distinct item-language combinations; " else " distinct items; ", sum(!item_use$calibrated), if (sum(!item_use$calibrated) == 1) " of them is" else " of them are", " not in the calibrated bank, and ", sum(!paste(items$item_uid, items$lang) %in% paste(item_use$item_uid, item_use$lang)), " calibrated ", if (by_language) "item-language combinations were" else "items were", " never shown. ", if (nrow(thin_items) > 0) paste0(nrow(thin_items), if (by_language) (if (nrow(thin_items) == 1) " item-language combination was" else " item-language combinations were") else if (nrow(thin_items) == 1) " item was" else " items were", " calibrated on fewer than ", min_calib, " responses, so their parameters are uncertain; they received ", fmt_pct(share_thin, 1), " of responses in this release.") else paste0("Every item was calibrated on ", min_calib, " or more responses.")) else paste0("Children answered ", fmt_n(nrow(item_use)), " distinct items.")`

# Item health

```{r item-health-text, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat(if (check_chance) paste(
  "Items answered below chance in a language (the upper end of the 95% CI of",
  "accuracy is below chance; items with 30 or more responses in that language)",
  "suggest a wrong answer key, a misleading picture or a translation problem.")
  else "Accuracy against chance is not meaningful for this task's items, so this check is not run.", "\n")
```

```{r item-health, eval=check_chance, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-item-health
#| fig-cap: "Accuracy against chance for each item in each language; items answered below chance in red."
item_lang |>
  mutate(language = lang_names[lang]) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = chance, y = accuracy, colour = below_chance)) +
  geom_abline(lty = 2, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.01, height = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(vars(language)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#CC3311", `FALSE` = "grey50"), guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.6)) +
  labs(x = "Chance", y = "Accuracy")
```

`r if (!check_chance) "" else if (any(item_lang$below_chance)) paste0("Answered below chance: ", with(filter(item_lang, below_chance), paste0(item_uid, " (", lang, ", ", f2(accuracy), " correct, n = ", n, ")", collapse = "; ")), ".") else "No item is answered below chance in any language."`

# Scores

```{r scores-age, fig.height=5.5}
#| label: fig-scores-age
#| fig-cap: "Scores on each child's first run by age, with a smooth for each dataset."
first_runs |>
  filter(!is.na(age)) |>
  by_ds() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = score, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 1, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_dataset(name = NULL) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 3, override.aes = list(alpha = 1))) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Score") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r score-se, eval=has_se, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-score-se
#| fig-cap: "Standard error of each score against the score."
first_runs |>
  filter(!is.na(score_se)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = score, y = score_se)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Score", y = "Standard error")
```

Within 5% of the score range from either end:
`r with(by_ds(ends), paste0(dataset_labels_named[dataset], " ", fmt_pct(low), " low and ", fmt_pct(high), " high", collapse = "; "))`.

# Reliability, stability and validity

```{r psychometrics, fig.height=5}
#| label: fig-psychometrics
#| fig-cap: "Empirical reliability (for scores with standard errors), correlation between a child's first two waves, and correlation with age, by dataset (95% CIs where available)."
bind_rows(
  reliability |> transmute(dataset, measure = "Reliability", r = reliability, lo = NA, hi = NA),
  retest |> transmute(dataset, measure = "Retest (first two waves)", r, lo, hi),
  age_cor |> transmute(dataset, measure = "Correlation with age", r, lo, hi)) |>
  by_ds() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = r, y = dataset_label, colour = dataset)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(measure)) +
  scale_colour_dataset(guide = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

```{r task-cor, fig.height=4.5}
#| label: fig-task-cor
#| fig-cap: "Correlation of this task's scores with each other task's, on children's first runs, standardized within dataset and pooled (95% CIs)."
task_cor |>
  mutate(other_task = reorder(other_task, r)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = r, y = other_task)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi)) +
  labs(x = glue("Correlation with {task_label}"), y = NULL)
```

`r if (nrow(retest) > 0) paste0("Retest pairs that change task version between waves: ", paste0(dataset_labels_named[retest$dataset], " ", fmt_pct(retest$version_change), " (", retest$n, " pairs, r = ", f2(retest$r), ")", collapse = "; "), ".") else ""`

`r task_label` correlates most strongly with
`r task_cor$other_task[1]` (r = `r f2(task_cor$r[1])`) and least with
`r task_cor$other_task[nrow(task_cor)]` (r = `r f2(task_cor$r[nrow(task_cor)])`).

# Time

```{r time, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-time
#| fig-cap: "Minutes per run by age, for the adaptive and fixed forms."
runs |>
  filter(!is.na(age), minutes < 60) |>
  mutate(form = if_else(adaptive, "adaptive", "fixed")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = minutes, colour = form)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 1, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(adaptive = "#4477AA", fixed = "#CC6677"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Minutes") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
